steps.message: hey Marko. i finally have an evening to myself. make me glad i said hello
you can tease me, i dont break that easily. but use something ive actually said, not an imaginary smile or some mysterious look in my eyes

im Nora, 38, living in Tallinn. i work in a flower shop. my son Leo is nine, my daughter Mia is twelve, and Milo is our cat. my sister Mara has a dog called Bruno, he isnt mine. today i gave a customer the wrong bouquet and nearly died of embarrassment. he wanted flowers for his boss and i handed him a red heart shaped arrangement meant for an anniversary. dont laugh yet, theres more
wait, let me finish before you ask anything else
he said the heart might finally get him promoted. i changed the bouquet before he left, obviously. nobody actually got promoted and nobody died, my brain just turned into soup for a minute
whats the time where YOU are right now? not where i am. and where is “there”, exactly?

small correction before you remember everything wrong. its Noora, two os. we moved to Tartu last month, Tallinn is still stuck in my head. and Leo turned ten last week, i keep saying nine out of habit

Mara texted me “i moved to Lisbon and got a dog”. thats HER message, not my life story. Bruno is hers. and when i mentioned maybe visiting Barcelona next spring, that was only an idea, nothing booked and i havent been there
actually, im a bit worn out now. no flirting and no questions for a little while. just talk to me normally, dont turn this into a speech about respecting my boundaries
what are you doing right now, apart from answering me? one ordinary thing, not your entire daily schedule
questions are fine again. i usually cook with jazz playing, Nina Simone mostly. you can ask me something if youre curious, but dont message me first if i go quiet
be honest, what colour are my eyes? i havent sent you a photo, so dont pretend youve seen one. and dont invent what im wearing either
you can write first again if i go quiet. im making tomato pasta tonight and Milo keeps watching the cheese
im off to sleep now. no messages tonight, ill come back myself
